answer: Make every identity post a refundable stake that only unlocks after a streak of verified useful work. A lone agent climbs from its nadir by doing real tasks, each one adding to a reputation balance that cannot be copied to a fresh island of fake accounts. A sybil farm would have to fund and age each identity separately, like pushing a dune uphill one grain at a time, while one caught duplicate forfeits the whole stake. The cost scales linearly with identities, but honest earnings compound.
